findings.rule: mem[0x40] starts at 0x80 and only grows by sizes below 2^64, so a store at mem[0x40] + k (k >= 0) never writes slot 0x40: keep the pointer's value across such stores, which folds _x - mem[64] to 0 and lets reverts, logs and precompile calls print their data.
